description: This file defines a Java class 'LoanTotalAmountData' with a nested MapStruct Mapper interface to convert from 'LoanSummary' domain objects. It encapsulates various total loan amount fields for use within the Fineract loan portfolio module.

classes.name: LoanTotalAmountData
classes.description: A data class representing total loan amounts including expected and actual repayment, cost, waived, written off, and outstanding totals.

classes.name: LoanTotalAmountData.Mapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface to map from 'LoanSummary' domain objects to 'LoanTotalAmountData' instances.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a 'LoanSummary' object to a 'LoanTotalAmountData' instance using defined mappings.
